# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 7: SEASONAL PREDICTOR INDICES (ALL TIMESCALES + UPWELLING + SALINITY)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Seasonal windows: Spring (Mar–May), Spawn (May–Jun), Larval (Jun–Jul),
## Settlement (Jul–Aug), Growth (Sep–Oct)
##
## Metrics: Min temp (upwelling proxy), Max temp (thermal stress),
##          CUTI (coastal upwelling transport), BEUTI (biologically effective
##          upwelling transport), Salinity (freshwater/upwelling balance),
##          Discharge (Columbia River flow — freshwater influence)

```{r}
# ── Strategy: merge ALL predictor data into a single long-format table ────
# per timescale (beach × year × month) BEFORE computing seasonal indices.
# Upwelling (BEUTI/CUTI) is coastwide — joining by year+month replicates
# values across beaches naturally. Salinity is beach-specific from IDW.
# Discharge is coastwide (same Columbia River value for all beaches).

# ── Function: compute ALL seasonal indices from merged long data ──────────
# Expects columns: beach, year, month, t_min, t_max, beuti, cuti, sal, q_mean
# Returns one row per beach × year with columns for active metrics only.
# Respects the environmental factor toggles defined in the toggle section.
compute_seasonal_indices <- function(merged_long) {
  out <- merged_long %>%
    group_by(beach, year) %>%
    summarise(
      # ── Minimum temperature windows (upwelling proxy) ───────────────────
      t_spring_min = if (use_temp_min) mean(t_min[month %in% 3:5],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_spawn_min  = if (use_temp_min) mean(t_min[month %in% 5:6],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_larval_min = if (use_temp_min) mean(t_min[month %in% 6:7],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_settle_min = if (use_temp_min) mean(t_min[month %in% 7:8],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_growth_min = if (use_temp_min) mean(t_min[month %in% 9:10], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── Maximum temperature windows (thermal stress proxy) ──────────────
      t_spring_max = if (use_temp_max) mean(t_max[month %in% 3:5],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_spawn_max  = if (use_temp_max) mean(t_max[month %in% 5:6],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_larval_max = if (use_temp_max) mean(t_max[month %in% 6:7],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_settle_max = if (use_temp_max) mean(t_max[month %in% 7:8],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      t_growth_max = if (use_temp_max) mean(t_max[month %in% 9:10], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── BEUTI windows (biologically effective upwelling) ────────────────
      beuti_spring = if (use_beuti) mean(beuti[month %in% 3:5],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      beuti_spawn  = if (use_beuti) mean(beuti[month %in% 5:6],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      beuti_larval = if (use_beuti) mean(beuti[month %in% 6:7],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      beuti_settle = if (use_beuti) mean(beuti[month %in% 7:8],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      beuti_growth = if (use_beuti) mean(beuti[month %in% 9:10], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── CUTI windows (coastal upwelling transport) ─────────────────────
      cuti_spring  = if (use_cuti) mean(cuti[month %in% 3:5],   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      cuti_spawn   = if (use_cuti) mean(cuti[month %in% 5:6],   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      cuti_larval  = if (use_cuti) mean(cuti[month %in% 6:7],   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      cuti_settle  = if (use_cuti) mean(cuti[month %in% 7:8],   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      cuti_growth  = if (use_cuti) mean(cuti[month %in% 9:10],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── Salinity windows ────────────────────────────────────────────────
      sal_spring   = if (use_salinity) mean(sal[month %in% 3:5],    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sal_spawn    = if (use_salinity) mean(sal[month %in% 5:6],    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sal_larval   = if (use_salinity) mean(sal[month %in% 6:7],    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sal_settle   = if (use_salinity) mean(sal[month %in% 7:8],    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sal_growth   = if (use_salinity) mean(sal[month %in% 9:10],   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── Columbia River discharge windows ────────────────────────────────
      q_spring     = if (use_discharge) mean(q_mean[month %in% 3:5],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      q_spawn      = if (use_discharge) mean(q_mean[month %in% 5:6],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      q_larval     = if (use_discharge) mean(q_mean[month %in% 6:7],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      q_settle     = if (use_discharge) mean(q_mean[month %in% 7:8],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      q_growth     = if (use_discharge) mean(q_mean[month %in% 9:10], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      # ── PDO windows (Pacific Decadal Oscillation) ───────────────────
      pdo_spring   = if (use_pdo) mean(pdo[month %in% 3:5],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      pdo_spawn    = if (use_pdo) mean(pdo[month %in% 5:6],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      pdo_larval   = if (use_pdo) mean(pdo[month %in% 6:7],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      pdo_settle   = if (use_pdo) mean(pdo[month %in% 7:8],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      pdo_growth   = if (use_pdo) mean(pdo[month %in% 9:10], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Replace NaN (from windows with no data) with NA
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(is.nan(.), NA_real_, .)))
  
  # Drop columns for disabled metrics (all-NA) to keep data tidy
  disabled_prefixes <- c(
    if (!use_temp_min)  "t_.*_min$",
    if (!use_temp_max)  "t_.*_max$",
    if (!use_beuti)     "^beuti_",
    if (!use_cuti)      "^cuti_",
    if (!use_salinity)  "^sal_",
    if (!use_discharge) "^q_",
    if (!use_pdo)       "^pdo_"
  )
  if (length(disabled_prefixes) > 0) {
    drop_pattern <- paste(disabled_prefixes, collapse = "|")
    drop_cols    <- grep(drop_pattern, names(out), value = TRUE)
    out <- out %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
  }
  
  out
}

# ── Helper: merge ALL predictor data into temp long table ───────────────
# Joins are conditional on environmental factor toggles.
# upwell_monthly has beach × year × month (latitude-matched per beach);
# wi_sal has beach × year × month (IDW-blended salinity);
# discharge_monthly has year × month (coastwide, replicated to all beaches)
merge_all_predictors <- function(temp_long, upwell_mo, sal_mo, q_mo = NULL, pdo_mo = NULL) {
  out <- temp_long %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(.data$month))
  
  # Upwelling (BEUTI/CUTI) — join if either index is active
  if (use_beuti || use_cuti) {
    cols_to_join <- c("beach", "year", "month")
    if (use_beuti) cols_to_join <- c(cols_to_join, "beuti")
    if (use_cuti)  cols_to_join <- c(cols_to_join, "cuti")
    out <- out %>%
      left_join(upwell_mo %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(.data$month)) %>% select(all_of(cols_to_join)),
                by = c("beach", "year", "month"))
  }
  if (!use_beuti) out <- out %>% mutate(beuti = NA_real_)
  if (!use_cuti)  out <- out %>% mutate(cuti  = NA_real_)
  
  # Salinity
  if (use_salinity && nrow(sal_mo) > 0) {
    out <- out %>%
      left_join(sal_mo %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(.data$month)) %>% select(beach, year, month, sal),
                by = c("beach", "year", "month"))
  } else {
    out <- out %>% mutate(sal = NA_real_)
  }
  
  # Discharge (coastwide — join by year+month only)
  if (use_discharge && !is.null(q_mo)) {
    out <- out %>%
      left_join(q_mo %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(.data$month)) %>% select(year, month, q_mean),
                by = c("year", "month"))
  } else {
    out <- out %>% mutate(q_mean = NA_real_)
  }
  
  # PDO (coastwide — join by year+month only, same value for all beaches)
  if (use_pdo && !is.null(pdo_mo)) {
    out <- out %>%
      left_join(pdo_mo %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(.data$month)) %>% select(year, month, pdo),
                by = c("year", "month"))
  } else {
    out <- out %>% mutate(pdo = NA_real_)
  }
  out
}

# ── Diagnostics: verify upwelling data structure before merging ──────────
cat("\n--- Upwelling monthly data check ---\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(upwell_monthly), "\n")
cat("Beaches:", paste(unique(upwell_monthly$beach), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Years:", n_distinct(upwell_monthly$year),
    "(", min(upwell_monthly$year), "to", max(upwell_monthly$year), ")\n")
cat("BEUTI range:", round(range(upwell_monthly$beuti, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("CUTI  range:", round(range(upwell_monthly$cuti,  na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("\n--- Latitude bin assignments ---\n")
beach_lat_bin %>% print()

# ── Monthly seasonal indices ──────────────────────────────────────────────
ti_monthly <- wi %>%
  rename(t_min = at_min, t_max = at_max) %>%
  merge_all_predictors(upwell_monthly, wi_sal, discharge_monthly, pdo_monthly) %>%
  compute_seasonal_indices()

# ── Half-monthly seasonal indices ─────────────────────────────────────────
ti_half_monthly <- wi_hm %>%
  rename(t_min = hm_min, t_max = hm_max) %>%
  merge_all_predictors(upwell_monthly, wi_sal, discharge_monthly, pdo_monthly) %>%
  compute_seasonal_indices()

# ── Weekly seasonal indices ───────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!is.null(wi_wk)) {
  ti_weekly <- wi_wk %>%
    rename(t_min = wk_min, t_max = wk_max) %>%
    merge_all_predictors(upwell_monthly, wi_sal, discharge_monthly, pdo_monthly) %>%
    compute_seasonal_indices()
  cat("Weekly:      ", nrow(ti_weekly), "rows\n")
} else {
  ti_weekly <- NULL
  cat("Weekly:       SKIPPED (wi_wk not available)\n")
}

cat("\n--- Seasonal index dimensions ---\n")
cat("Monthly:     ", nrow(ti_monthly), "rows,", ncol(ti_monthly), "cols\n")
cat("Half-monthly:", nrow(ti_half_monthly), "rows\n")

# ── Verify upwelling indices vary across years (critical check) ──────────
if (use_beuti || use_cuti) {
  cat("\n--- Upwelling index verification (monthly, first beach) ---\n")
  check_beach <- ti_monthly %>% filter(beach == beach_order[1])
  check_vars <- c(if (use_beuti) "beuti_spring", if (use_cuti) "cuti_spring")
  for (v in check_vars) {
    if (v %in% names(check_beach)) {
      vals <- check_beach[[v]]
      cat(v, ": n =", sum(!is.na(vals)),
          ", range =", round(range(vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
          ", sd =", round(sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("\n--- Upwelling indices: DISABLED (use_beuti and use_cuti both FALSE) ---\n")
}

cat("\nSalinity coverage:",
    if (use_salinity) paste(sum(!is.na(ti_monthly$sal_spring)), "of",
    nrow(ti_monthly), "beach-years have salinity data") else "DISABLED (use_salinity = FALSE)", "\n")
cat("Discharge coverage:",
    if (use_discharge) paste(sum(!is.na(ti_monthly$q_spring)), "of",
    nrow(ti_monthly), "beach-years have discharge data") else "DISABLED (use_discharge = FALSE)", "\n")
cat("PDO coverage:",
    if (use_pdo) paste(sum(!is.na(ti_monthly$pdo_spring)), "of",
    nrow(ti_monthly), "beach-years have PDO data") else "DISABLED (use_pdo = FALSE)", "\n")
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 8: FULLY FACTORIAL PREDICTOR–RECRUITMENT LAG ANALYSIS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Investigates how seasonal predictors (min/max temperature, BEUTI, CUTI,
salinity) predict razor clam pre-recruit and recruit abundance at time lags
of 0, 1, and 2 years. Fully factorial across: timescale (monthly, half-
monthly, weekly) × metric (6) × recruit type (2) × seasonal window (5) ×
lag (3).

```{r}
# ── Predictor variable name vectors — built dynamically from toggles ─────
# Only active metrics enter the predictor catalog. Disabled metrics are
# excluded entirely from lag correlations, heatmaps, and model selection.
tv_min   <- if (use_temp_min)  c("t_spring_min",  "t_spawn_min",  "t_larval_min",  "t_settle_min",  "t_growth_min") else character(0)
tv_max   <- if (use_temp_max)  c("t_spring_max",  "t_spawn_max",  "t_larval_max",  "t_settle_max",  "t_growth_max") else character(0)
tv_beuti <- if (use_beuti)     c("beuti_spring",  "beuti_spawn",  "beuti_larval",  "beuti_settle",  "beuti_growth")  else character(0)
tv_cuti  <- if (use_cuti)      c("cuti_spring",   "cuti_spawn",   "cuti_larval",   "cuti_settle",   "cuti_growth")   else character(0)
tv_sal   <- if (use_salinity)  c("sal_spring",    "sal_spawn",    "sal_larval",    "sal_settle",    "sal_growth")    else character(0)
tv_q     <- if (use_discharge) c("q_spring",      "q_spawn",      "q_larval",      "q_settle",      "q_growth")     else character(0)
tv_pdo   <- if (use_pdo)      c("pdo_spring",    "pdo_spawn",    "pdo_larval",    "pdo_settle",    "pdo_growth")    else character(0)
tv_all   <- c(tv_min, tv_max, tv_beuti, tv_cuti, tv_sal, tv_q, tv_pdo)

stopifnot("No predictors are active — enable at least one env toggle" = length(tv_all) > 0)

# Window and metric label lookups (only for active metrics)
window_labels <- c("Spring", "Spawn", "Larval", "Settle", "Growth")
tv_labels <- setNames(rep(window_labels, length(tv_all) / 5), tv_all)

# Build metric_labels dynamically from the active tv_* vectors
metric_labels_list <- c(
  if (use_temp_min)  setNames(rep("Min", 5),       tv_min),
  if (use_temp_max)  setNames(rep("Max", 5),       tv_max),
  if (use_beuti)     setNames(rep("BEUTI", 5),     tv_beuti),
  if (use_cuti)      setNames(rep("CUTI", 5),      tv_cuti),
  if (use_salinity)  setNames(rep("Salinity", 5),  tv_sal),
  if (use_discharge) setNames(rep("Discharge", 5), tv_q),
  if (use_pdo)       setNames(rep("PDO", 5),       tv_pdo)
)
metric_labels <- metric_labels_list

# Ordered metric levels for consistent plotting (only active ones)
all_metric_levels <- c("Min", "Max", "CUTI", "BEUTI", "Salinity", "Discharge", "PDO")
metric_levels <- intersect(all_metric_levels, unique(metric_labels))

cat("\n--- Active predictor catalog ---\n")
cat("Metrics:", paste(metric_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total predictor columns:", length(tv_all),
    "(", length(tv_all)/5, "metrics × 5 windows)\n")

# ── Lag range ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Razor clams reach recruit size (>75mm) in under 1 year (WA growth model).
# Adults (>120mm) are ~2+ years old. Lags 0–5
# capture the full life-history pathway:
#   Lag 0 = current-year survival / growth conditions (YOY spawning signal)
#   Lag 1 = spawning signal for juveniles / sub-adult recruitment
#   Lag 2 = spawning signal for sub-adults and youngest adults
#   Lag 3–5 = spawning/larval conditions for older adults
max_lag <- 5
lag_range <- 0:max_lag

# ── Recruitment base table ────────────────────────────────────────────────
rec <- dat_wtmp %>%
  select(beach, season, pre_recruits, recruits) %>%
  mutate(sy = as.integer(str_extract(season, "^[0-9]{4}")))

# ── Master function: run full lag correlation for one timescale ────────────
# Returns a tibble with columns: beach, lag, temp_var, window, metric,
#   r_pre, p_pre, r_rec, p_rec, sig_pre, sig_rec, timescale
run_lag_correlation <- function(ti_data, timescale_label) {
  
  # Join recruitment to predictor indices at lags 0 through max_lag
  rec_lag <- map_dfr(lag_range, function(lg) {
    rec %>%
      left_join(
        ti_data %>% mutate(sy = year + lg) %>% select(-year),
        by = c("beach", "sy")
      ) %>%
      mutate(lag = lg)
  })
  
  # Compute Pearson correlations for all combinations
  cor_result <- rec_lag %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(tv_all), names_to = "temp_var", values_to = "temp_val") %>%
    group_by(beach, lag, temp_var) %>%
    summarise(
      n       = sum(!is.na(temp_val) & !is.na(pre_recruits)),
      r_pre   = cor_p(log1p(pre_recruits), temp_val)["r"],
      p_pre   = cor_p(log1p(pre_recruits), temp_val)["p"],
      r_rec   = cor_p(log1p(recruits),     temp_val)["r"],
      p_rec   = cor_p(log1p(recruits),     temp_val)["p"],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      window    = tv_labels[temp_var],
      metric    = metric_labels[temp_var],
      sig_pre   = case_when(p_pre < 0.001 ~ "***", p_pre < 0.01 ~ "**",
                            p_pre < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE          ~ ""),
      sig_rec   = case_when(p_rec < 0.001 ~ "***", p_rec < 0.01 ~ "**",
                            p_rec < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE          ~ ""),
      timescale = timescale_label
    )
  
  return(list(cor_result = cor_result, rec_lag = rec_lag))
}

# ── Run the factorial analysis for available timescales ────────────────────
# Build a named list of seasonal index tables — only include timescales
# that successfully completed IDW blending and seasonal index computation.
ti_list <- list()
ti_list[["monthly"]]      <- ti_monthly
ti_list[["half_monthly"]]  <- ti_half_monthly
if (!is.null(ti_weekly)) ti_list[["weekly"]] <- ti_weekly

# Run lag correlations for each available timescale
results_list <- list()
for (ts_name in names(ti_list)) {
  res <- run_lag_correlation(ti_list[[ts_name]], ts_name)
  results_list[[ts_name]] <- res
}

# Combine all correlation results into one master table
cor_all <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, function(x) x$cor_result))

# Build the rec_lag lookup for scatter plots (only available timescales)
all_rec_lags <- lapply(results_list, function(x) x$rec_lag)

# Report available timescales
available_timescales <- names(ti_list)

cat("\n--- Factorial analysis dimensions ---\n")
cat("Total correlation rows:", nrow(cor_all), "\n")
cat("Timescales completed:", paste(available_timescales, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Metrics:",    paste(unique(cor_all$metric), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Windows:",    paste(unique(cor_all$window), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 9: SAVE CORRELATION MATRICES AS EXCEL FILES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r}
# ── Save each timescale's correlation results as a formatted Excel workbook ──
# Each workbook contains one sheet per beach. Columns are clearly labeled with
# the temperature metric, seasonal window, lag, and recruit type.

for (ts in available_timescales) {
  
  cor_subset <- cor_all %>% filter(timescale == ts)
  
  # Reshape to a reader-friendly wide format
  cor_wide <- cor_subset %>%
    select(beach, lag, window, metric, r_pre, p_pre, sig_pre, r_rec, p_rec, sig_rec, n) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(r_pre, r_rec), ~round(., 3)),
      across(c(p_pre, p_rec), ~round(., 4))
    ) %>%
    arrange(beach, metric, window, lag)
  
  # Create workbook with one sheet per beach + a combined sheet
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  # Combined sheet (all beaches)
  addWorksheet(wb, "All_Beaches")
  writeData(wb, "All_Beaches", cor_wide)
  
  # Individual beach sheets
  for (bch in beach_order) {
    bch_data <- cor_wide %>% filter(beach == bch)
    if (nrow(bch_data) > 0) {
      sheet_name <- gsub(" ", "_", bch)
      addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      writeData(wb, sheet_name, bch_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Station info sheet — which stations contributed at this timescale
  if (ts == "monthly") {
    stn_info <- stn_attr_monthly %>%
      group_by(beach) %>%
      summarise(
        primary_station_id   = names(which.max(table(dom_stn))),
        all_contributing_ids = paste(unique(unlist(str_split(all_stns, ", "))), collapse = ", "),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(stations %>% select(station, Name), by = c("primary_station_id" = "station")) %>%
      rename(primary_station_name = Name)
  } else {
    stn_tbl <- if (ts == "half_monthly") wi_hm else wi_wk
    stn_info <- stn_tbl %>%
      group_by(beach) %>%
      summarise(
        primary_station_id = names(which.max(table(dom_stn))),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(stations %>% select(station, Name), by = c("primary_station_id" = "station")) %>%
      rename(primary_station_name = Name)
  }
  
  addWorksheet(wb, "Station_Info")
  writeData(wb, "Station_Info", stn_info)
  
  out_xlsx <- file.path(folder_name, "excel",
                        paste0("correlation_matrix_", ts, ".xlsx"))
  saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", out_xlsx, "\n")
}

# ── Also save the combined master table across all timescales ──────────────
wb_master <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb_master, "All_Results")
writeData(wb_master, "All_Results",
          cor_all %>%
            select(timescale, beach, lag, window, metric,
                   r_pre, p_pre, sig_pre, r_rec, p_rec, sig_rec, n) %>%
            mutate(across(c(r_pre, r_rec), ~round(., 3)),
                   across(c(p_pre, p_rec), ~round(., 4))) %>%
            arrange(timescale, beach, metric, window, lag))
saveWorkbook(wb_master,
             file.path(folder_name, "excel", "correlation_matrix_ALL_timescales.xlsx"),
             overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Saved: master correlation Excel\n")
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 10: HEATMAPS — ALL METRICS (PER TIMESCALE)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r fig.width=18, fig.height=18}
# ── Dynamic metric → display label mapping (respects toggles) ────────────
# Only active metrics get labels; used for all heatmap factor() calls.
all_metric_display <- c(
  Min        = "Min temp\n(upwelling proxy)",
  Max        = "Max temp\n(thermal stress)",
  CUTI       = "CUTI\n(transport)",
  BEUTI      = "BEUTI\n(nutrients)",
  Salinity   = "Salinity\n(freshwater)",
  Discharge  = "Discharge\n(river flow)",
  PDO        = "PDO\n(decadal regime)"
)
active_metric_display <- all_metric_display[metric_levels]

# ── Heatmap helper function ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Used for both best-lag and fixed-lag heatmaps.
# Takes a pre-processed dataframe with columns: beach, recruit_type, window,
#   metric, r, p, sig, lag, cell_label
make_heatmap <- function(plot_data, title_text, subtitle_text) {
  plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      window = factor(window, levels = rev(window_labels)),
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_levels,
                      labels = active_metric_display)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = window, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_tile(data = . %>% filter(p < 0.05),
              aes(x = metric, y = window),
              fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), size = 2.4, color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r",
                         na.value = "grey90") +
    facet_grid(beach ~ recruit_type) +
    labs(x        = "Predictor metric",
         y        = "Seasonal window",
         title    = title_text,
         subtitle = subtitle_text) +
    my_theme +
    theme(legend.position  = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 9))
}

# ── Helper: prepare long-format correlation data for heatmaps ────────────
prepare_cor_long <- function(cor_subset) {
  cor_subset %>%
    select(beach, lag, temp_var, window, metric, r_pre, r_rec, sig_pre, sig_rec, p_pre, p_rec) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(r_pre, r_rec),
                 names_to  = "recruit_type",
                 values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(
      p            = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", p_pre, p_rec),
      sig          = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", sig_pre, sig_rec),
      recruit_type = recode(recruit_type, r_pre = "Pre-recruits", r_rec = "Recruits"),
      beach        = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE)
    )
}

for (ts in available_timescales) {
  
  ts_label <- switch(ts,
    "monthly"      = "Monthly",
    "half_monthly" = "Half-Monthly",
    "weekly"       = "Weekly"
  )
  
  cor_ts_long <- cor_all %>%
    filter(timescale == ts) %>%
    prepare_cor_long()
  
  # ── (a) Best-lag heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  # For each beach × recruit_type × predictor, select the lag with highest |r|.
  cor_best <- cor_ts_long %>%
    group_by(beach, recruit_type, temp_var, window, metric) %>%
    slice_max(abs(r), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cell_label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), sig, "\n(L", lag, ")"))
  
  p_heat_best <- make_heatmap(
    cor_best,
    paste0("Predictor–recruitment correlation (best lag) — ", ts_label, " resolution"),
    paste0("Black outline = p < 0.05 | Best of lags 0–", max_lag,
           " | Min/Max = temp; CUTI/BEUTI = upwelling; Sal = salinity")
  )
  
  print(p_heat_best)
  if (save_heatmaps) {
    ggsave(file.path(folder_name, ts,
                     paste0("heatmap_all_metrics_", ts, ".png")),
           plot = p_heat_best, width = 16, height = 18, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  # ── (b) Fixed-lag heatmaps — one per lag ───────────────────────────────
  # Shows correlation at a single specific lag across all windows and metrics.
  lag_subtitles <- c(
    "Lag 0: same year — YOY spawning signal; current-year survival for older classes",
    "Lag 1: 1 yr prior — juvenile spawning signal; sub-adult recruitment",
    "Lag 2: 2 yr prior — sub-adult and youngest adult spawning signal",
    "Lag 3: 3 yr prior — adult spawning/larval conditions",
    "Lag 4: 4 yr prior — adult spawning/larval conditions",
    "Lag 5: 5 yr prior — oldest adult cohort spawning signal"
  )
  
  for (lg in lag_range) {
    cor_lag <- cor_ts_long %>%
      filter(lag == lg) %>%
      mutate(cell_label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), sig))
    
    p_heat_lag <- make_heatmap(
      cor_lag,
      paste0("Predictor–recruitment correlation at Lag ", lg, " — ", ts_label),
      paste0("Black outline = p < 0.05 | ", lag_subtitles[lg + 1])
    )
    
    print(p_heat_lag)
    if (save_heatmaps) {
      ggsave(file.path(folder_name, ts,
                       paste0("heatmap_lag", lg, "_", ts, ".png")),
             plot = p_heat_lag, width = 16, height = 18, dpi = 300)
    }
  }
  
  # ── (c) Best-lag-number heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────
  # Fill = which lag (0–5) produced the highest |r|.
  # Shows geographic gradient: shorter lags at southern beaches (faster
  # growth to recruit size), longer lags at northern beaches.
  # Text shows r, significance, and lag number.
  
  cor_best_num <- cor_ts_long %>%
    group_by(beach, recruit_type, temp_var, window, metric) %>%
    slice_max(abs(r), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  p_heat_lagnum <- cor_best_num %>%
    mutate(
      window     = factor(window, levels = rev(window_labels)),
      metric     = factor(metric, levels = metric_levels,
                          labels = active_metric_display),
      cell_label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), sig, "\n(L", lag, ")"),
      sig_flag   = p < 0.05
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = window, fill = lag)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_tile(data = . %>% filter(sig_flag),
              aes(x = metric, y = window),
              fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), size = 2.4, color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", limits = c(0, max_lag),
                         breaks = lag_range, name = "Best lag\n(years)") +
    facet_grid(beach ~ recruit_type) +
    labs(x        = "Predictor metric",
         y        = "Seasonal window",
         title    = paste0("Optimal lag (years) for predictor–recruitment correlation — ", ts_label),
         subtitle = paste0("Fill = best lag (0–", max_lag,
                           "); text = r, significance | Black outline = p < 0.05")) +
    my_theme +
    theme(legend.position  = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 9))
  
  print(p_heat_lagnum)
  if (save_heatmaps) {
    ggsave(file.path(folder_name, ts,
                     paste0("heatmap_best_lag_number_", ts, ".png")),
           plot = p_heat_lagnum, width = 16, height = 18, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 11: SCATTER PLOTS (PER TIMESCALE)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=13}
# ── Scatter plots: predictor vs log(recruitment) by beach and lag ─────────
# Generate scatter plots for key windows at each timescale.
# Faceted: rows = beach (N→S), columns = lag.

# Full label lookup for all 30 predictor variables
pred_labels <- c(
  t_spring_min  = "Spring min temp (Mar–May, °C)",
  t_spawn_min   = "Spawn min temp (May–Jun, °C)",
  t_larval_min  = "Larval min temp (Jun–Jul, °C)",
  t_settle_min  = "Settle min temp (Jul–Aug, °C)",
  t_growth_min  = "Growth min temp (Sep–Oct, °C)",
  t_spring_max  = "Spring max temp (Mar–May, °C)",
  t_spawn_max   = "Spawn max temp (May–Jun, °C)",
  t_larval_max  = "Larval max temp (Jun–Jul, °C)",
  t_settle_max  = "Settle max temp (Jul–Aug, °C)",
  t_growth_max  = "Growth max temp (Sep–Oct, °C)",
  beuti_spring  = "Spring BEUTI (Mar–May)",
  beuti_spawn   = "Spawn BEUTI (May–Jun)",
  beuti_larval  = "Larval BEUTI (Jun–Jul)",
  beuti_settle  = "Settle BEUTI (Jul–Aug)",
  beuti_growth  = "Growth BEUTI (Sep–Oct)",
  cuti_spring   = "Spring CUTI (Mar–May)",
  cuti_spawn    = "Spawn CUTI (May–Jun)",
  cuti_larval   = "Larval CUTI (Jun–Jul)",
  cuti_settle   = "Settle CUTI (Jul–Aug)",
  cuti_growth   = "Growth CUTI (Sep–Oct)",
  sal_spring    = "Spring salinity (Mar–May, PSU)",
  sal_spawn     = "Spawn salinity (May–Jun, PSU)",
  sal_larval    = "Larval salinity (Jun–Jul, PSU)",
  sal_settle    = "Settle salinity (Jul–Aug, PSU)",
  sal_growth    = "Growth salinity (Sep–Oct, PSU)",
  q_spring      = "Spring discharge (Mar–May, m³/s)",
  q_spawn       = "Spawn discharge (May–Jun, m³/s)",
  q_larval      = "Larval discharge (Jun–Jul, m³/s)",
  q_settle      = "Settle discharge (Jul–Aug, m³/s)",
  q_growth      = "Growth discharge (Sep–Oct, m³/s)",
  pdo_spring    = "Spring PDO index (Mar–May)",
  pdo_spawn     = "Spawn PDO index (May–Jun)",
  pdo_larval    = "Larval PDO index (Jun–Jul)",
  pdo_settle    = "Settle PDO index (Jul–Aug)",
  pdo_growth    = "Growth PDO index (Sep–Oct)"
)

lag_labels <- setNames(
  paste0("Lag ", lag_range, " (", c("same year", "1 yr prior", "2 yr prior",
                                     "3 yr prior", "4 yr prior", "5 yr prior"), ")"),
  as.character(lag_range)
)

# ── Scatter plot function ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_scatter <- function(rec_lag_data, tvar, rvar, rlabel, ts_label) {
  rec_lag_data %>%
    mutate(beach = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[tvar]]), !is.na(.data[[rvar]])) %>%
    mutate(lag = factor(lag, levels = lag_range, labels = lag_labels)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[tvar]], y = log1p(.data[[rvar]]))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "grey30") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "steelblue", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_grid(beach ~ lag) +
    labs(
      x     = pred_labels[tvar],
      y     = paste0("log(", rlabel, " + 1)"),
      title = paste0(rlabel, " ~ ", pred_labels[tvar], " [", ts_label, "]")
    ) +
    my_theme +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
          strip.text        = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"))
}

# ── Generate scatter plots for key variables at each timescale ─────────────
# Spawn and settle windows across all active metrics
scatter_vars <- c("t_spawn_min", "t_settle_min", "t_spawn_max", "t_settle_max",
                  "beuti_spawn", "beuti_settle", "cuti_spawn", "cuti_settle",
                  "sal_spawn", "sal_settle", "q_spawn", "q_settle",
                  "pdo_spawn", "pdo_settle")
# Keep only variables that are in the active predictor catalog
scatter_vars <- intersect(scatter_vars, tv_all)

for (ts in names(all_rec_lags)) {
  ts_label <- switch(ts, monthly = "Monthly", half_monthly = "Half-Monthly", weekly = "Weekly")
  rl <- all_rec_lags[[ts]]
  
  for (tvar in scatter_vars) {
    for (rtype in list(c("pre_recruits", "Pre-recruits"), c("recruits", "Recruits"))) {
      p <- plot_scatter(rl, tvar, rtype[1], rtype[2], ts_label)
      print(p)
      if (save_scatter) {
        fname <- paste0("scatter_", rtype[1], "_", tvar, "_", ts, ".png")
        ggsave(file.path(folder_name, ts, fname), plot = p, width = 20, height = 13, dpi = 300)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
  for (tvar in tv_all) {

      mutate(

  # ── (b) Best-lag bar plot across all windows — one per metric ──────────
  for (met_name in names(metric_tv_list)) {

    met_file <- metric_file_label[met_name]
    
    best_lag_ts <- cor_ts %>%
      filter(temp_var %in% met_vars) %>%
      select(beach, lag, temp_var, r_pre, r_rec, p_pre, p_rec, sig_pre, sig_rec) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(r_pre, r_rec), names_to = "recruit_type", values_to = "r") %>%
      mutate(
        p            = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", p_pre, p_rec),

      ) %>%
      group_by(beach, recruit_type, temp_var) %>%

      ungroup() %>%

    p_best_bar <- best_lag_ts %>%
      mutate(

      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#d73027", "FALSE" = "#4575b4"), guide = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25)) +
      facet_grid(beach ~ recruit_type) +
      labs(x     = "Seasonal window",
           y     = "Pearson r (at best lag)",
           title = paste0("Best-lag ", met_name, " correlation [", ts_label, "]"),
           subtitle = paste0("Labels: r, significance, best lag (L0–L", max_lag, ")")) +
      my_theme +
      theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
            strip.text       = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
            axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 9))
    
    print(p_best_bar)
    if (save_barplots) {
      ggsave(file.path(folder_name, ts,
                       paste0("barplot_best_lag_", met_file, "_", ts, ".png")),
             plot = p_best_bar, width = 12, height = 16, dpi = 300)
    }
    
    # ── (c) Fixed-lag bar plots — one per metric × lag ─────────────────────
    all_lag_ts <- cor_ts %>%
      filter(temp_var %in% met_vars) %>%
      select(beach, lag, temp_var, r_pre, r_rec, p_pre, p_rec, sig_pre, sig_rec) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(r_pre, r_rec), names_to = "recruit_type", values_to = "r") %>%
      mutate(
        p            = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", p_pre, p_rec),

      )
    
    for (lg in lag_range) {

        ) %>%

        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25)) +
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 13: HALF-CORRPLOT MATRICES (UPDATED STYLE)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=13}
# ── Updated corrplot: upper-triangle heatmap with r-values overlaid ────────
# Significant correlations (p < 0.05) are bolded. Abbreviated labels keep
# the matrix readable. One plot per beach, saved to corrplots/ subfolder.
#
# The matrix includes: log(pre-recruits), log(recruits), and all 5 metric
# windows at representative lags (using monthly resolution as default).
# Uses min temp as the representative temperature metric.
# With 6 lags (0–5), a full corrplot would be too dense (>100 columns).
# Instead, use representative lags: 0 (current), 2 (pre-recruit), 4 (recruit).

# Build wide recruitment + predictor data
rec_base <- rec %>% select(beach, sy, pre_recruits, recruits)

# Use min temp + BEUTI + CUTI + salinity + discharge at representative lags
# Use active metrics at representative windows (up to 4 windows per metric)
# Safe indexing: head() returns character(0) for empty inputs, not NA
tv_corr <- c(head(tv_min, 4), head(tv_beuti, 4), head(tv_cuti, 4),
             head(tv_sal, 4), head(tv_q, 4), head(tv_pdo, 4))  # only active metrics contribute
corr_lags <- c(0, 2, 4)  # Representative lags for corrplot

# Dynamically join each representative lag
rec_wide <- rec_base
for (lg in corr_lags) {
  lag_suffix <- paste0("_L", lg)
  rec_wide <- rec_wide %>%
    left_join(ti_monthly %>% select(beach, year, all_of(tv_corr)) %>%
                mutate(sy = year + lg) %>% select(-year) %>%
                rename_with(~paste0(., lag_suffix), all_of(tv_corr)),
              by = c("beach", "sy"))
}
rec_wide <- rec_wide %>%
  mutate(
    log_pre = log1p(pre_recruits),
    log_rec = log1p(recruits)
  )

# Column order and abbreviated labels
mat_cols <- c("log_pre", "log_rec",
              paste0(rep(tv_corr, length(corr_lags)),
                     rep(paste0("_L", corr_lags), each = length(tv_corr))))

# Abbreviated labels: 4 windows × 5 metrics × 3 representative lags = 60 + 2 recruit = 62
win_short <- c("Spr", "Spn", "Lrv", "Stl")
met_short <- c("Mn", "B", "C", "S", "Q")  # Min, BEUTI, CUTI, Salinity, Discharge
mat_labels <- c("Pre", "Rec")
for (lg in corr_lags) {
  for (im in seq_along(met_short)) {
    for (iw in seq_along(win_short)) {
      mat_labels <- c(mat_labels, paste0(met_short[im], win_short[iw], lg))
    }
  }
}

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(200)

# ── Generate half-corrplot for each beach ─────────────────────────────────
for (bch in beach_order) {
  
  mat_data <- rec_wide %>%
    filter(beach == bch) %>%
    select(any_of(mat_cols))
  
  # Drop columns that are all NA (e.g., salinity before 2014)
  mat_data <- mat_data[, colSums(!is.na(mat_data)) >= 5]
  mat_data <- mat_data %>% na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(mat_data) < 6 || ncol(mat_data) < 5) next
  
  # Update labels to match available columns
  available_labels <- mat_labels[mat_cols %in% names(mat_data)]
  
  # Compute correlation and p-value matrices
  cor_mat  <- cor(mat_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- available_labels
  
  p_mat    <- corrplot::cor.mtest(mat_data, conf.level = 0.95)$p
  colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- available_labels
  
  # ── Build ggplot-based half-corrplot with r-values on colored tiles ────
  cor_df <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
    mutate(var1 = rownames(cor_mat)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r")
  
  p_df <- as.data.frame(p_mat) %>%
    mutate(var1 = rownames(p_mat)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "p")
  
  plot_df <- cor_df %>%
    left_join(p_df, by = c("var1", "var2")) %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = factor(var1, levels = available_labels),
      var2 = factor(var2, levels = available_labels),
      idx1 = as.numeric(var1),
      idx2 = as.numeric(var2),
      sig  = p < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(idx2 >= idx1)
  
  p_corr <- plot_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = var2, y = fct_rev(var1), fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = plot_df %>% filter(sig),
              aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)),
              size = 1.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    geom_text(data = plot_df %>% filter(!sig),
              aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)),
              size = 1.6, fontface = "plain", color = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r") +
    labs(title = paste("Half-corrplot —", bch, "(min temp, BEUTI, CUTI, salinity)"),
         subtitle = "Mn=Min temp, B=BEUTI, C=CUTI, S=Salinity | 0/1/2=lag | Spr/Spn/Lrv/Stl=window",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    my_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title       = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8))
  
  print(p_corr)
  
  if (save_corrplots) {
    ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "corrplots",
                     paste0("half_corrplot_", gsub(" ", "_", bch), ".png")),
           plot = p_corr, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  # ── Also save the raw correlation matrix to Excel ──────────────────────
  wb_corr <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb_corr, "r_values")
  writeData(wb_corr, "r_values", as.data.frame(cor_mat), rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb_corr, "p_values")
  writeData(wb_corr, "p_values", as.data.frame(p_mat), rowNames = TRUE)
  saveWorkbook(wb_corr,
               file.path(folder_name, "excel",
                         paste0("corrmatrix_", gsub(" ", "_", bch), ".xlsx")),
               overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 14: AUTOCORRELATION ANALYSIS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## 14a. Recruitment ACF and PACF

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=18}
# ── Prepare annual recruitment series ──────────────────────────────────────
rec_ts <- dat_wtmp %>%
  select(beach, season, pre_recruits, recruits) %>%
  mutate(
    sy      = as.integer(str_extract(season, "^[0-9]{4}")),
    log_pre = log1p(pre_recruits),
    log_rec = log1p(recruits),
    beach   = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(beach, sy)

# Check for internal gaps
cat("\n--- Recruitment series completeness ---\n")
rec_ts %>%
  group_by(beach) %>%
  summarise(
    n_seasons  = n(),
    n_pre_na   = sum(is.na(log_pre)),
    n_rec_na   = sum(is.na(log_rec)),
    year_range = paste(min(sy), max(sy), sep = "–"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

# ── ACF and PACF of log(recruitment) by beach ─────────────────────────────
acf_dat <- rec_ts %>%
  group_by(beach) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    bind_rows(
      tidy_acf(.x$log_pre, type = "correlation") %>% mutate(recruit = "Pre-recruits", func = "ACF"),
      tidy_acf(.x$log_pre, type = "partial")     %>% mutate(recruit = "Pre-recruits", func = "PACF"),
      tidy_acf(.x$log_rec, type = "correlation") %>% mutate(recruit = "Recruits",     func = "ACF"),
      tidy_acf(.x$log_rec, type = "partial")     %>% mutate(recruit = "Recruits",     func = "PACF")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(lag > 0) %>%
  mutate(beach = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE))

p_acf <- acf_dat %>%
  mutate(func = factor(func, levels = c("ACF", "PACF"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept =  ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = lag, yend = 0, color = abs(acf) > ci),
               linewidth = 3.5, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(aes(color = abs(acf) > ci), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey60", "TRUE" = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_grid(beach + recruit ~ func, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x     = "Lag (years)",
       y     = "Autocorrelation",
       title = "ACF and PACF of log(recruitment) by beach",
       subtitle = "Red bars exceed the 95% confidence bound (dashed blue lines)") +
  my_theme +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
        strip.text       = element_text(size = 9,  color = "black"),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = 10))

print(p_acf)
if (save_acf) {
  ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "periodicity", "acf_pacf_recruitment.png"),
       plot = p_acf, width = 10, height = 18, dpi = 300)
}
```

## 14b. Predictor ACF — autocorrelation of seasonal predictor indices

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=16}
# ── ACF of seasonal predictor indices per beach ──────────────────────────
# Checks whether predictors themselves show multi-year persistence or
# cyclicity — important for interpreting predictor–recruitment correlations.

# Compute ACF for each beach × seasonal window × metric
pred_acf_list <- list()

for (bch in beach_order) {
  ti_bch <- ti_monthly %>% filter(beach == bch) %>% arrange(year)
  
  for (tvar in tv_all) {
    x <- ti_bch[[tvar]]
    if (all(is.na(x))) next
    acf_result <- tidy_acf(x, type = "correlation")
    if (!is.null(acf_result)) {
      pred_acf_list[[length(pred_acf_list) + 1]] <- acf_result %>%
        mutate(
          beach    = bch,
          temp_var = tvar,
          window   = tv_labels[tvar],
          metric   = metric_labels[tvar]
        )
    }
  }
}

pred_acf_dat <- bind_rows(pred_acf_list) %>%
  filter(lag > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    beach  = factor(beach,  levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE),
    window = factor(window, levels = window_labels)
  )

# ── Plot ACF for each active metric ──────────────────────────────────
met_subtitle_lookup <- c(
  Min = "Min temp: upwelling proxy",
  Max = "Max temp: thermal stress proxy",
  BEUTI = "Biologically Effective Upwelling Transport Index",
  CUTI = "Coastal Upwelling Transport Index",
  Salinity = "IDW-blended mean salinity",
  Discharge = "Columbia River discharge (The Dalles, m³/s)"
)

for (met in metric_levels) {
  met_lower <- tolower(gsub(" ", "_", met))
  met_subtitle <- met_subtitle_lookup[met]
  
  p_acf_met <- pred_acf_dat %>%
    filter(metric == met) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept =  ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = lag, yend = 0, color = abs(acf) > ci),
                 linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "butt") +
    geom_point(aes(color = abs(acf) > ci), size = 1.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey60", "TRUE" = "darkorange"), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
    facet_grid(beach ~ window) +
    labs(x     = "Lag (years)",
         y     = "Autocorrelation",
         title = paste0("ACF of ", met, " by beach and seasonal window"),
         subtitle = paste0(met_subtitle, " — orange bars exceed 95% CI")) +
    my_theme +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
          axis.text        = element_text(size = 9))
  
  print(p_acf_met)
  if (save_acf) {
    ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "periodicity",
                     paste0("acf_", met_lower, "_by_window.png")),
           plot = p_acf_met, width = 16, height = 14, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 15: SPECTRAL ANALYSIS (PERIODOGRAM)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
# ── Periodogram of recruitment ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Decomposes the recruitment time series into constituent frequencies to
# reveal dominant multi-year cycles. Smoothed Daniell kernel reduces noise.

spec_dat <- rec_ts %>%
  group_by(beach) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    bind_rows(
      tidy_spec(.x$log_pre, "Pre-recruits"),
      tidy_spec(.x$log_rec, "Recruits")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(beach = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE))

# Mark dominant period for each beach × series
dominant_periods <- spec_dat %>%
  filter(period <= 15, period >= 2) %>%
  group_by(beach, series) %>%
  slice_max(spec, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(round(period, 1), " yr"))

p_spec <- spec_dat %>%
  filter(period <= 15, period >= 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = spec, color = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = dominant_periods,
             aes(xintercept = period, color = series),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_label(data = dominant_periods,
             aes(x = period, y = spec * 1.15, label = label, color = series),
             size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pre-recruits" = "steelblue", "Recruits" = "firebrick"),
                     name = "Recruit class") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 15)) +
  facet_wrap(~beach, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x     = "Period (years)",
       y     = "Spectral density",
       title = "Smoothed periodogram of log(recruitment) by beach",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines mark the dominant period in each series") +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
        strip.text       = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"))

print(p_spec)
if (save_spectral) {
  ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "periodicity", "periodogram_recruitment.png"),
         plot = p_spec, width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)
}

cat("\n--- Dominant recruitment periods by beach ---\n")
dominant_periods %>%
  select(beach, series, dominant_period_yr = period, spectral_density = spec) %>%
  mutate(dominant_period_yr = round(dominant_period_yr, 2)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 16: PRE-WHITENING — ACF AFTER REMOVING BEST PREDICTOR EFFECT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=20}
# ── Fine-lag analysis: individual month × lag correlation ──────────────────
# For each beach × recruit type, correlate predictors in each month (1–12)
# at each lag (0–5) with recruitment. Provides fine-grained "best month
# + best lag" for pre-whitening. Uses active environmental metrics only.

# Build the list of active metrics for fine-lag analysis (outside loop for scoping)
active_fine_metrics <- c(
  if (use_temp_min)  "min",
  if (use_temp_max)  "max",
  if (use_beuti)     "beuti",
  if (use_cuti)      "cuti",
  if (use_salinity)  "salinity",
  if (use_discharge) "discharge"
)
cat("Active fine-lag metrics:", paste(active_fine_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n")

fine_lag <- map_dfr(lag_range, function(lg) {
  map_dfr(1:12, function(mo) {
    
    # Temperature for this month from monthly IDW data
    temp_mo <- wi %>%
      filter(.data$month == mo) %>%
      select(beach, year, at_min, at_max) %>%
      mutate(sy = year + lg)
    
    # Upwelling indices for this month (beach-specific latitude bins)
    upwell_mo <- if (use_beuti || use_cuti) {
      upwell_monthly %>%
        filter(.data$month == mo) %>%
        select(beach, year, any_of(c(
          if (use_beuti) "beuti",
          if (use_cuti)  "cuti"
        ))) %>%
        mutate(sy = year + lg)
    } else NULL
    
    # Salinity for this month (beach-specific)
    sal_mo <- if (use_salinity) {
      wi_sal %>%
        filter(.data$month == mo) %>%
        select(beach, year, sal) %>%
        mutate(sy = year + lg)
    } else NULL
    
    # Discharge for this month (coastwide — join by year only)
    q_mo_fine <- if (use_discharge && !is.null(discharge_monthly)) {
      discharge_monthly %>%
        filter(.data$month == mo) %>%
        select(year, q_mean) %>%
        mutate(sy = year + lg)
    } else NULL
    
    # Join to recruitment — only join active factors
    rec_temp <- rec %>%
      left_join(temp_mo, by = c("beach", "sy"))
    if (!is.null(upwell_mo)) {
      join_cols <- intersect(c("beuti", "cuti"), names(upwell_mo))
      rec_temp <- rec_temp %>%
        left_join(upwell_mo %>% select(beach, sy, all_of(join_cols)), by = c("beach", "sy"))
    }
    if (!is.null(sal_mo)) {
      rec_temp <- rec_temp %>%
        left_join(sal_mo %>% select(beach, sy, sal), by = c("beach", "sy"))
    }
    if (!is.null(q_mo_fine)) {
      rec_temp <- rec_temp %>%
        left_join(q_mo_fine %>% select(sy, q_mean), by = "sy")
    }
    
    # Compute correlations for all active metrics
    map_dfr(active_fine_metrics, function(met) {
      temp_col <- switch(met, min = "at_min", max = "at_max",
                         beuti = "beuti", cuti = "cuti", salinity = "sal",
                         discharge = "q_mean")
      
      rec_filt <- rec_temp %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[temp_col]]))
      if (nrow(rec_filt) < 5) {
        return(tibble(beach = character(), r_pre = numeric(), p_pre = numeric(),
                      r_rec = numeric(), p_rec = numeric(), lag_yr = integer(),
                      month = integer(), metric = character()))
      }
      
      rec_filt %>%
        group_by(beach) %>%
        summarise(
          r_pre = cor_p(log1p(pre_recruits), .data[[temp_col]])["r"],
          p_pre = cor_p(log1p(pre_recruits), .data[[temp_col]])["p"],
          r_rec = cor_p(log1p(recruits),     .data[[temp_col]])["r"],
          p_rec = cor_p(log1p(recruits),     .data[[temp_col]])["p"],
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(lag_yr = lg, month = mo, metric = met)
    })
  })
}) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(r_pre, r_rec),
    names_to  = "recruit_type",
    values_to = "r"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", p_pre, p_rec),
    recruit_type = recode(recruit_type, r_pre = "pre_recruits", r_rec = "recruits")
  ) %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, metric, month, lag_yr, r, p)

# ── Best month + lag per beach × recruit type ────────────────────────────
# Prefer min temp for pre-whitening; fall back to first available metric
prewhiten_metric <- if (use_temp_min) "min" else if (use_temp_max) "max" else active_fine_metrics[1]
cat("Pre-whitening reference metric:", prewhiten_metric, "\n")

fine_lag_best <- fine_lag %>%
  filter(metric == prewhiten_metric) %>%
  group_by(beach, recruit_type) %>%
  slice_max(abs(r), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(recruit_type = recode(recruit_type,
                               pre_recruits = "Pre-recruits",
                               recruits     = "Recruits")) %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, lag_yr, month)

cat("\n--- Best month + lag for pre-whitening (", prewhiten_metric, "temp ) ---\n")
fine_lag_best %>% print(n = Inf)

# ── Build best_month_lag table for joining ─────────────────────────────────
best_month_lag <- rec_ts %>%
  select(beach, sy) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  cross_join(tibble(recruit_type = c("Pre-recruits", "Recruits"))) %>%
  left_join(fine_lag_best, by = c("beach", "recruit_type")) %>%
  mutate(metric = prewhiten_metric)

# ── Pre-whitening: build temperature series and compute residuals ──────────
# Select the column matching the pre-whitening metric
prewhiten_col <- switch(prewhiten_metric,
                         min = "at_min", max = "at_max",
                         beuti = "beuti", cuti = "cuti",
                         salinity = "sal", discharge = "q_mean",
                         "at_min")

rec_resid <- best_month_lag %>%
  select(-any_of(c("sy"))) %>%
  distinct(beach, recruit_type, lag_yr, month, metric) %>%
  left_join(fine_lag_best, by = c("beach", "recruit_type"),
            suffix = c("", ".dup")) %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, lag_yr, month) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    temp_series = list({
      curr_beach <- beach
      curr_month <- month
      curr_lag   <- lag_yr
      
      # Select the data source and column based on the pre-whitening metric
      pw_data <- switch(prewhiten_metric,
        min = , max = wi %>%
          filter(beach == curr_beach, .data$month == curr_month) %>%
          mutate(sy_temp = year + curr_lag) %>%
          select(sy_temp, best_temp = !!sym(prewhiten_col)),
        beuti = , cuti = upwell_monthly %>%
          filter(beach == curr_beach, .data$month == curr_month) %>%
          mutate(sy_temp = year + curr_lag) %>%
          select(sy_temp, best_temp = !!sym(prewhiten_col)),
        salinity = wi_sal %>%
          filter(beach == curr_beach, .data$month == curr_month) %>%
          mutate(sy_temp = year + curr_lag) %>%
          select(sy_temp, best_temp = sal),
        discharge = if (!is.null(discharge_monthly)) {
          discharge_monthly %>%
            filter(.data$month == curr_month) %>%
            mutate(sy_temp = year + curr_lag) %>%
            select(sy_temp, best_temp = q_mean)
        } else tibble(sy_temp = integer(), best_temp = numeric())
      )
      
      rec_ts %>%
        filter(beach == curr_beach) %>%
        left_join(pw_data, by = c("sy" = "sy_temp")) %>%
        select(beach, sy, log_pre, log_rec, best_temp)
    }),
    best_month = month.abb[month]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Compute residuals and ACF ─────────────────────────────────────────────
resid_acf_dat <- rec_resid %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    resid_data = list({
      d <- temp_series %>% na.omit()
      rv <- if (recruit_type == "Pre-recruits") d$log_pre else d$log_rec
      if (nrow(d) > 6 && var(d$best_temp, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        lm(rv ~ best_temp, data = d)$residuals
      } else {
        rv
      }
    }),
    acf_resid = list(tidy_acf(resid_data, type = "correlation") %>%
                       mutate(model = paste0("Residuals (", prewhiten_metric, " temp removed)"))),
    acf_raw = list({
      raw_vec <- if (recruit_type == "Pre-recruits") temp_series$log_pre else temp_series$log_rec
      tidy_acf(raw_vec, type = "correlation") %>%
        mutate(model = "Raw log(recruitment)")
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(acf_both = map2(acf_resid, acf_raw, bind_rows)) %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, acf_both) %>%
  unnest(acf_both) %>%
  filter(lag > 0) %>%
  mutate(beach = factor(beach, levels = beach_order, ordered = TRUE))

# ── Plot: pre-whitened vs raw ACF ─────────────────────────────────────────
p_prewhiten <- resid_acf_dat %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = c("Raw log(recruitment)",
                                      paste0("Residuals (", prewhiten_metric, " temp removed)"))),
    sig   = abs(acf) > ci
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6, color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept =  ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -ci), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = lag, yend = 0, color = sig),
                linewidth = 3, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey65", "TRUE" = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_grid(beach + recruit_type ~ model) +
  labs(x        = "Lag (years)",
       y        = "Autocorrelation",
       title    = paste0("ACF before and after removing best ", prewhiten_metric, " predictor"),
       subtitle = paste0("Persistent structure in residuals = ", prewhiten_metric, "-independent periodicity")) +
  my_theme +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
        strip.text       = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black"),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = 9))

print(p_prewhiten)
if (save_prewhiten) {
  ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "periodicity", "acf_prewhitened_vs_raw.png"),
         plot = p_prewhiten, width = 11, height = 20, dpi = 300)
}
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 18: PREDICTIVE RECRUITMENT MODELS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# For each beach × recruit type:
#   1. Automatically select top 2 environmental predictors from different
#      mechanistic categories (to avoid collinearity)
#   2. Fit candidate models: null, 1-predictor, 2-predictor, each ± density
#      dependence (lagged abundance)
#   3. Compare via AICc
#   4. Validate via LOOCV and rolling-origin cross-validation
#   5. Produce diagnostic and prediction plots

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# ── Mechanistic categories for predictor grouping ────────────────────────
# Top 2 predictors must come from different categories to ensure
# orthogonal information content. Only active metrics are included.
mech_category <- c(
  if (use_temp_min)  setNames(rep("upwelling_proxy", length(tv_min)),  tv_min),
  if (use_temp_max)  setNames(rep("thermal_stress",  length(tv_max)),  tv_max),
  if (use_cuti)      setNames(rep("transport",       length(tv_cuti)), tv_cuti),
  if (use_beuti)     setNames(rep("nutrient_flux",   length(tv_beuti)),tv_beuti),
  if (use_salinity)  setNames(rep("freshwater",      length(tv_sal)),  tv_sal),
  if (use_discharge) setNames(rep("river_flow",      length(tv_q)),    tv_q),
  if (use_pdo)       setNames(rep("decadal_regime",  length(tv_pdo)),  tv_pdo)
)

# ── Predictor selection: top 2 from different mechanistic categories ─────
# Uses monthly timescale correlations. For each beach × recruit type,
# rank all predictor-lag combinations by |r|, then select top 1 overall
# and top 1 from a different mechanistic category.

cor_monthly <- cor_all %>% filter(timescale == "monthly")

select_top_predictors <- function(cor_data) {
  
  # Pivot to one row per beach × recruit_type × predictor × lag
  cor_long <- cor_data %>%
    select(beach, lag, temp_var, window, metric, r_pre, r_rec, p_pre, p_rec, n) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(r_pre, r_rec),
                 names_to = "recruit_type", values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(
      p = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre", p_pre, p_rec),
      n_eff = ifelse(recruit_type == "r_pre",
                     n,  # n already computed for pre-recruits
                     n), # same n for recruits from same join
      recruit_type = recode(recruit_type,
                            r_pre = "Pre-recruits", r_rec = "Recruits"),
      abs_r    = abs(r),
      category = mech_category[temp_var],
      pred_id  = paste0(temp_var, "_L", lag)  # unique predictor identifier
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(r), n_eff >= 8)  # require minimum 8 observations
  
  # For each beach × recruit type, select top 2 from different categories
  selections <- cor_long %>%
    group_by(beach, recruit_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_r)) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      # Top 1: highest |r| overall
      top1 <- .x %>% slice(1)
      # Top 2: highest |r| from a DIFFERENT mechanistic category
      top2 <- .x %>%
        filter(category != top1$category[1]) %>%
        slice(1)
      bind_rows(
        top1 %>% mutate(rank = 1),
        top2 %>% mutate(rank = 2)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(beach, recruit_type, rank, pred_id, temp_var, lag, window,
           metric, category, r, p, n_eff)
  
  return(selections)
}

pred_selections <- select_top_predictors(cor_monthly)

cat("\n=== Selected predictors per beach × recruit type ===\n")
pred_selections %>%
  mutate(r = round(r, 3), p = round(p, 4)) %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, rank, pred_id, category, r, p, n_eff) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# ── Build modeling dataset ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reconstruct wide-format data with selected predictors at their optimal
# lags, plus lagged abundance for density-dependent models.

# Get monthly rec_lag (all lags already joined)
rl_monthly <- all_rec_lags[["monthly"]]

build_model_data <- function(beach_name, rtype, sel_preds, rec_lag_data, rec_data) {
  
  preds <- sel_preds %>%
    filter(beach == beach_name, recruit_type == rtype)
  
  if (nrow(preds) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Response variable
  resp_col <- ifelse(rtype == "Pre-recruits", "pre_recruits", "recruits")
  
  # Start with recruitment data for this beach
  md <- rec_data %>%
    filter(beach == beach_name) %>%
    select(sy, pre_recruits, recruits) %>%
    mutate(
      log_resp = log1p(.data[[resp_col]]),
      # Lagged abundance for density-dependent model
      log_resp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(log_resp, 1, order_by = sy)
    )
  
  # Join each selected predictor at its optimal lag
  for (i in 1:nrow(preds)) {
    tvar <- preds$temp_var[i]
    lg   <- preds$lag[i]
    pid  <- paste0("env", i)  # generic name: env1, env2
    
    pred_data <- rec_lag_data %>%
      filter(beach == beach_name, lag == lg) %>%
      select(sy, all_of(tvar)) %>%
      rename(!!pid := !!tvar)
    
    md <- md %>% left_join(pred_data, by = "sy")
  }
  
  # Add metadata
  attr(md, "beach")        <- beach_name
  attr(md, "recruit_type") <- rtype
  attr(md, "pred1_id")     <- preds$pred_id[1]
  attr(md, "pred2_id")     <- ifelse(nrow(preds) >= 2, preds$pred_id[2], NA)
  attr(md, "pred1_label")  <- paste0(preds$metric[1], " ", preds$window[1], " L", preds$lag[1])
  attr(md, "pred2_label")  <- ifelse(nrow(preds) >= 2,
                                      paste0(preds$metric[2], " ", preds$window[2], " L", preds$lag[2]),
                                      NA)
  
  return(md)
}

# ── AICc computation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
AICc <- function(model) {
  n <- nobs(model)
  k <- length(coef(model)) + 1  # +1 for residual variance
  aic <- AIC(model)
  aic + (2 * k * (k + 1)) / (n - k - 1)
}

# ── LOOCV function ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
loocv <- function(formula, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  pred_vals <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    fit_i    <- lm(formula, data = data[-i, ])
    pred_vals[i] <- predict(fit_i, newdata = data[i, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  obs <- data$log_resp
  ss_res <- sum((obs - pred_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((obs - mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  q2     <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
  rmse   <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  list(q2 = q2, rmse = rmse, predicted = pred_vals)
}

# ── Rolling-origin cross-validation ──────────────────────────────────────
# Train on years 1..t, predict year t+1. Minimum training window = 10 years.
rolling_cv <- function(formula, data, min_train = 10) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  if (n <= min_train + 1) return(list(q2 = NA, rmse = NA, predicted = rep(NA, n)))
  
  pred_vals <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (t in min_train:(n - 1)) {
    fit_t <- tryCatch(
      lm(formula, data = data[1:t, ]),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(fit_t)) {
      pred_vals[t + 1] <- predict(fit_t, newdata = data[t + 1, , drop = FALSE])
    }
  }
  
  valid_idx <- which(!is.na(pred_vals))
  if (length(valid_idx) < 3) return(list(q2 = NA, rmse = NA, predicted = pred_vals))
  
  obs    <- data$log_resp[valid_idx]
  prd    <- pred_vals[valid_idx]
  ss_res <- sum((obs - prd)^2)
  ss_tot <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)
  q2     <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
  rmse   <- sqrt(mean((obs - prd)^2))
  list(q2 = q2, rmse = rmse, predicted = pred_vals)
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ── Fit candidate models for each beach × recruit type ──────────────────
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

model_results <- list()  # store all results

for (bch in beach_order) {
  for (rtype in c("Pre-recruits", "Recruits")) {
    
    key <- paste(bch, rtype, sep = " | ")
    
    # Build dataset
    md <- build_model_data(bch, rtype, pred_selections, rl_monthly, rec)
    if (is.null(md)) next
    
    # Remove rows with NA in predictors
    has_env2 <- "env2" %in% names(md) && any(!is.na(md$env2))
    
    # Candidate formulas
    formulas <- list(
      "Null"           = log_resp ~ 1,
      "Env1"           = log_resp ~ env1,
      "Env1 + DD"      = log_resp ~ env1 + log_resp_lag1
    )
    
    if (has_env2) {
      formulas[["Env1 + Env2"]]      <- log_resp ~ env1 + env2
      formulas[["Env1 + Env2 + DD"]] <- log_resp ~ env1 + env2 + log_resp_lag1
      formulas[["Env2"]]             <- log_resp ~ env2
      formulas[["Env2 + DD"]]        <- log_resp ~ env2 + log_resp_lag1
    }
    
    # Also test density-dependence alone
    formulas[["DD only"]] <- log_resp ~ log_resp_lag1
    
    # Fit all candidate models
    model_fits  <- list()
    model_stats <- list()
    
    for (mname in names(formulas)) {
      
      # Determine which columns are needed
      needed_vars <- all.vars(formulas[[mname]])
      md_complete <- md %>% select(sy, all_of(needed_vars)) %>% na.omit()
      
      if (nrow(md_complete) < 8) next  # need minimum 8 observations
      
      # Fit model
      fit <- tryCatch(lm(formulas[[mname]], data = md_complete), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fit)) next
      
      # In-sample stats
      r2      <- summary(fit)$r.squared
      adj_r2  <- summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
      aicc    <- tryCatch(AICc(fit), error = function(e) NA)
      n_obs   <- nobs(fit)
      k_params <- length(coef(fit))
      
      # LOOCV
      cv_loo  <- tryCatch(loocv(formulas[[mname]], md_complete),
                           error = function(e) list(q2 = NA, rmse = NA, predicted = NULL))
      
      # Rolling-origin CV
      cv_roll <- tryCatch(rolling_cv(formulas[[mname]], md_complete),
                           error = function(e) list(q2 = NA, rmse = NA, predicted = NULL))
      
      model_fits[[mname]] <- fit
      model_stats[[mname]] <- tibble(
        model     = mname,
        n         = n_obs,
        k         = k_params,
        R2        = round(r2, 3),
        adj_R2    = round(adj_r2, 3),
        AICc      = round(aicc, 1),
        Q2_LOOCV  = round(cv_loo$q2, 3),
        RMSE_LOOCV = round(cv_loo$rmse, 3),
        Q2_rolling = round(cv_roll$q2, 3),
        RMSE_rolling = round(cv_roll$rmse, 3)
      )
    }
    
    if (length(model_stats) == 0) next
    
    stats_df <- bind_rows(model_stats) %>%
      mutate(delta_AICc = round(AICc - min(AICc, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) %>%
      arrange(AICc)
    
    model_results[[key]] <- list(
      beach        = bch,
      recruit_type = rtype,
      model_data   = md,
      pred1_label  = attr(md, "pred1_label"),
      pred2_label  = attr(md, "pred2_label"),
      pred1_id     = attr(md, "pred1_id"),
      pred2_id     = attr(md, "pred2_id"),
      formulas     = formulas,
      fits         = model_fits,
      stats        = stats_df,
      best_model   = stats_df$model[1]  # lowest AICc
    )
    
    cat("\n--- ", key, " ---\n")
    print(stats_df, n = Inf)
  }
}
```

```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ── Model comparison summary table ──────────────────────────────────────
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Combine all model comparison tables
all_model_stats <- map_dfr(model_results, function(res) {
  res$stats %>%
    mutate(beach = res$beach,
           recruit_type = res$recruit_type,
           pred1 = res$pred1_id,
           pred2 = res$pred2_id,
           .before = 1)
})

# ── Best model per beach × recruit type ──────────────────────────────────
best_models <- map_dfr(model_results, function(res) {
  best  <- res$stats %>% slice(1)
  bfit  <- res$fits[[best$model]]
  coefs <- coef(bfit)
  
  # Build equation string
  terms <- names(coefs)
  eq_parts <- sprintf("%.3f", coefs[1])  # intercept
  for (i in 2:length(terms)) {
    tname <- terms[i]
    # Resolve predictor label
    label <- case_when(
      tname == "env1" ~ res$pred1_id,
      tname == "env2" ~ res$pred2_id,
      tname == "log_resp_lag1" ~ "log(abund_{t-1})",
      TRUE ~ tname
    )
    sign <- ifelse(coefs[i] >= 0, " + ", " - ")
    eq_parts <- paste0(eq_parts, sign, sprintf("%.3f", abs(coefs[i])), " × ", label)
  }
  equation <- paste0("log(abund+1) = ", eq_parts)
  
  tibble(
    beach        = res$beach,
    recruit_type = res$recruit_type,
    best_model   = best$model,
    pred1        = res$pred1_label,
    pred2        = res$pred2_label,
    equation     = equation,
    n            = best$n,
    R2           = best$R2,
    adj_R2       = best$adj_R2,
    AICc         = best$AICc,
    delta_2nd    = res$stats$delta_AICc[min(2, nrow(res$stats))],
    Q2_LOOCV     = best$Q2_LOOCV,
    Q2_rolling   = best$Q2_rolling,
    RMSE_LOOCV   = best$RMSE_LOOCV
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(beach = factor(beach, levels = beach_order)) %>%
  arrange(beach, recruit_type)

cat("\n=== Best predictive model per beach × recruit type ===\n")
best_models %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, best_model, R2, adj_R2, Q2_LOOCV, Q2_rolling) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\n=== Model equations ===\n")
best_models %>%
  select(beach, recruit_type, equation) %>%
  pwalk(function(beach, recruit_type, equation, ...) {
    cat(paste0(beach, " [", recruit_type, "]: ", equation, "\n"))
  })
```

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ── Diagnostic plots for best models ────────────────────────────────────
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Four-panel diagnostic for each beach × recruit type:
#   (1) Observed vs predicted (in-sample + LOOCV)
#   (2) Residuals vs fitted
#   (3) Residual ACF
#   (4) Q-Q plot

diag_plots <- list()

for (key in names(model_results)) {
  
  res   <- model_results[[key]]
  bfit  <- res$fits[[res$best_model]]
  md    <- res$model_data
  bch   <- res$beach
  rtype <- res$recruit_type
  
  if (is.null(bfit)) next
  
  # Get complete data used by the model
  needed <- all.vars(res$formulas[[res$best_model]])
  md_complete <- md %>% select(sy, all_of(needed)) %>% na.omit()
  
  # In-sample predictions
  md_complete$fitted   <- fitted(bfit)
  md_complete$residual <- residuals(bfit)
  
  # LOOCV predictions
  cv_loo <- tryCatch(loocv(res$formulas[[res$best_model]], md_complete),
                      error = function(e) list(predicted = rep(NA, nrow(md_complete))))
  md_complete$loo_pred <- cv_loo$predicted
  
  # Panel 1: Observed vs Predicted
  p1 <- md_complete %>%
    select(sy, Observed = log_resp, Fitted = fitted, LOOCV = loo_pred) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Fitted, LOOCV), names_to = "type", values_to = "predicted") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = predicted, y = Observed, color = type, shape = type)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, lty = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Fitted = "firebrick", LOOCV = "steelblue")) +
    labs(x = "Predicted log(abundance + 1)", y = "Observed log(abundance + 1)",
         title = "Observed vs Predicted", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    my_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  # Panel 2: Residuals vs fitted
  p2 <- md_complete %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fitted, y = residual)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick",
                linewidth = 0.8, span = 1) +
    labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Residuals",
         title = "Residuals vs Fitted") +
    my_theme
  
  # Panel 3: Residual ACF
  acf_data <- tidy_acf(md_complete$residual, lag_max = 8)
  p3 <- if (!is.null(acf_data)) {
    acf_data %>%
      filter(lag > 0) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1) * acf_data$ci[1], lty = 2, color = "blue") +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
      labs(x = "Lag (years)", y = "ACF", title = "Residual ACF") +
      my_theme
  } else {
    ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Insufficient data") + my_theme
  }
  
  # Panel 4: Q-Q plot
  p4 <- md_complete %>%
    mutate(
      theoretical = qqnorm(residual, plot.it = FALSE)$x,
      sample      = qqnorm(residual, plot.it = FALSE)$y
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = mean(md_complete$residual),
                slope = sd(md_complete$residual), lty = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles",
         title = "Normal Q-Q") +
    my_theme
  
  # Combine panels
  p_diag <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = paste0(bch, " — ", rtype),
      subtitle = paste0("Best model: ", res$best_model,
                        " | R² = ", round(summary(bfit)$r.squared, 3),
                        " | Q²(LOOCV) = ", round(cv_loo$q2, 3)),
      theme    = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
    )
  
  diag_plots[[key]] <- p_diag
}

for (key in names(diag_plots)) {
  print(diag_plots[[key]])
  
  if (save_models) {
    res <- model_results[[key]]
    fname <- paste0("model_diagnostics_",
                    gsub(" ", "_", tolower(res$beach)), "_",
                    gsub("-", "", tolower(res$recruit_type)), ".png")
    ggsave(file.path(folder_name, "models", fname),
           plot = diag_plots[[key]], width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r}
wb_models <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Best model summary

          best_models %>%
            select(beach, recruit_type, best_model, pred1, pred2,
                   n, R2, adj_R2, AICc, Q2_LOOCV, Q2_rolling, RMSE_LOOCV, equation))

          pred_selections %>%
            mutate(r = round(r, 3), p = round(p, 4)) %>%
            select(beach, recruit_type, rank, pred_id, category,
                   metric, window, lag, r, p, n_eff))

# Sheet 4: Coefficients for all best models
coef_table <- map_dfr(model_results, function(res) {
  bfit <- res$fits[[res$best_model]]
  if (is.null(bfit)) return(NULL)
  tibble(
    beach        = res$beach,
    recruit_type = res$recruit_type,
    model        = res$best_model,

    estimate     = round(coef(bfit), 4),
    std_error    = round(summary(bfit)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"], 4),
    t_value      = round(summary(bfit)$coefficients[, "t value"], 3),
    p_value      = round(summary(bfit)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"], 4)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      predictor_label = case_when(
        term == "(Intercept)"   ~ "Intercept",
        term == "env1"          ~ res$pred1_id,
        term == "env2"          ~ res$pred2_id,
        term == "log_resp_lag1" ~ "log(abundance_{t-1})",
        TRUE                    ~ term
      )
    )
})

addWorksheet(wb_models, "Coefficients")
writeData(wb_models, "Coefficients", coef_table)

# Sheet 5: Predicted vs observed values for best models
pred_obs_table <- map_dfr(model_results, function(res) {
  bfit <- res$fits[[res$best_model]]
  if (is.null(bfit)) return(NULL)
  
  needed <- all.vars(res$formulas[[res$best_model]])

  md_complete$fitted <- fitted(bfit)
  
  cv <- tryCatch(loocv(res$formulas[[res$best_model]], md_complete),

  md_complete$loo_pred <- cv$predicted
  
  md_complete %>%
    mutate(
      beach        = res$beach,
      recruit_type = res$recruit_type,

      .before = 1

             file.path(folder_name, "models", "predictive_models.xlsx"),

cat("\n=== Predictive model outputs saved to:", file.path(folder_name, "models"), "===\n")
```
